entities.intent: A specific dish and its available ordering path
What the ingredient is and practical ways to use it
A culinary tradition and the food that defines it
How a specific cooking method works
The specific branch at its actual address

relationship_rules.geography: Keep located_on, nearby and delivers_to separate. Geometric proximity never proves delivery coverage.
relationship_rules.branches: One brand entity, distinct branch IDs and addresses; no repeated generic brand-only titles.
relationship_rules.links: Render useful selected relationships as server-side descriptive links, not every entity connected to every entity.
relationship_rules.radius: Context-specific geographic query; preserve exact distance and method privately. No claim of full-city coverage until measured.
relationship_rules.dishes: An ingredient mention is not an allergen certification; retain actual menu provenance separately.

nutrition_layer.owner_requested: Scientific useful healthy-food information throughout relevant pages
nutrition_layer.public_module: Short practical nutrition note appropriate to the entity, with a relevant source and clear raw/cooked and serving basis when numbers are shown
scientific_limits: Ingredient properties are not proof of the nutrient content of a served dish
Home-style does not automatically mean healthy
No generic healthy badge on every item
No raw-food values silently reused for cooked food
nutrition_layer.SEO_ownership: Nutrition is a relevant supporting section on existing entity pages; avoid an automatic duplicate healthy-food URL for every page
nutrition_layer.state: Two HE/EN hub modules and three source-linked ingredient notes LIVE in editorial1.2.2: chickpea, tahini and olive oil. Registry in editorial-release/plugin/ingredient-nutrition.json. Quantitative profiles, dish-specific notes and full-site coverage still pending. Batch future additions rather than one release per ingredient.

editorial_contract.economy: Reuse normalized facts and templates; batch long writing through connected ChatGPT Pro, medium writing through the owner's selected high-reasoning ChatGPT. Primary agent handles architecture, short corrections and verification. No per-visitor text generation.
editorial_contract.publication: Each page must answer a distinct useful question. A map record can remain a record until there is useful page content; do not manufacture paragraphs or businesses.
